name: Ground Cherry

facts.what: Small fruit inside a papery husk
facts.how: Raw when ripe, or into jam and sauce

caution: Eat ONLY fruit that is ripe and golden inside a dry, tan husk. The green unripe fruit, leaves, and stems are toxic (nightshade family). Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A wild tomatillo: each fruit hangs inside a Chinese-lantern husk. Ripe fruit falls to the ground and yellows; that is your only safe signal.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Ripe ground cherries taste of sweet tomato and pineapple, wonderful raw or cooked into a jam.
